decisions.reason: Identifies the exact expression; busy is AttachButton's function-scoped local unresolvable in AttachmentChips; empty occurrences return null before the map, and a present occurrence in plain phase makes the left guard falsy so busy evaluates -> ReferenceError.
Render throw is caught by the per-slot-entry error boundary unmounting the whole dock entry; the separate input.left attach-button entry survives; failure is console-only, no UI banner.

Grounds attribution in the shipped v0.2.10 artifact and maintainer note, notes the diff contradicts the built artifact on the disabled hunk and that imageItem is computed before callback-scoped status/record; proposes a v0.2.10 data-present mount plus rollback/re-add isolation without overclaiming about historical users.

Removes the dangling busy term preserving the phase guard (or properly lifting shared state), hardens record.items with ?? [] and event.target.closest?.(), and moves imageItem inside the map callback where record/status are defined.

Data-present plain-phase render smoke with DOM assertions, boundary-contract check, and zero console errors; explains empty-state vacuous passes and that node --check only parses and cannot resolve free identifiers; mandates the smoke as a pre-ship gate.
